results.title: 'Cry Myself To Sleep Every Night': Influencer Who Earned ₹20 Lakh In August 2026 Gets Emotional Over Losing Instagram Followers - VIDEO
results.description: An influencer who claimed to have earned ₹20 lakh from Instagram in August 2026 has opened up about her struggles with declining followers and engagement. She revealed that her target of reaching 200,000 followers remains unfulfilled, while plans to move to Mumbai have also stalled. In an emotional video, she urged followers not to unfollow her and encouraged others to stay hopeful
